items.name: JUMP Ft. Lauderdale: Senior VIP Audition
items.when: This weekend at the Broward County Convention Center; VIP winners and runners-up are announced at the Sunday afternoon Closing Show.
items.age_rule: Senior is 16-19, by age on January 1, 2027. Must be registered for the full workshop and in the Senior room. Independent dancers can't win VIP.
items.cost: Workshop registration through your studio; the scholarship page lists no separate audition fee.
items.why_john: Winner or runner-up gets a Dance Awards workshop scholarship plus eligibility for the 2027 Best Dancer competition, which is the whole goal.

items.name: 24 Seven Daytona Beach: Non-Stop Dancer Audition
items.when: November 13-15, 2026 at the Ocean Center; the Non-Stop Dancer audition follows a jazz or lyrical combo class.
items.age_rule: Senior is 16-19, by age on January 1, 2027. Full workshop registration and the age-appropriate room are required.
items.cost: Full workshop registration; check with 24 Seven or your studio for the price.
items.why_john: Non-Stop Dancer winners and runners-up are eligible for 2027 Best Dancer, so this is a second door in if JUMP doesn't land, and it's an hour from home.

items.name: Tremaine Orlando
items.when: November 21-22, 2026 at the Renaissance Orlando at SeaWorld.
items.why_john: A home-town convention with scholarships and a Dancer of the Year (D.O.T.Y.) program, and no flight needed.

items.name: NUVO Orlando: Breakout Artist Audition
items.when: January 8-10, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency Orlando; NUVO also stops in Atlanta Feb 5-7 and Miami May 28-30, 2027.
items.age_rule: Senior is 16-19, by age on January 1, 2027. Full workshop registration required; independent dancers can't win Breakout Artist.
items.cost: Full workshop registration; price not on the scholarship page.
items.why_john: Breakout Artist winners and runners-up get 2027 Best Dancer eligibility plus a Dance Awards workshop scholarship, right in Orlando.

items.name: NYCDA Orlando: Outstanding Dancer
items.when: February 5-7, 2027; NYCDA also stops in Savannah Mar 5-7 and Atlanta Apr 23-25, 2027.
items.age_rule: Senior division; NYCDA names one male dancer per city for its Regional Outstanding Dancer award.
items.why_john: A Regional OD award includes a full scholarship to National Workshop classes, and National Senior ODs get $1,000 each plus a lifetime convention scholarship.

items.name: JUMP Orlando: Senior VIP Audition (second shot)
items.when: March 12-14, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency Orlando; JUMP Atlanta is April 16-18, 2027 at the Atlanta Marriott Marquis.
items.age_rule: Senior is 16-19, by age on January 1, 2027. Class scholarship winners can audition in other cities to become a Regional VIP.
items.why_john: If Ft. Lauderdale doesn't hand you VIP, this is another JUMP VIP audition in your own city before The Dance Awards.

items.name: RADIX Orlando
items.when: April 2-4, 2027 at the Orlando World Center Marriott; RADIX Atlanta is February 26-28, 2027.
items.age_rule: Scholarships for ages 8-19, by age on January 1, 2027; 20+ not eligible.
items.why_john: Cutting Edge and Choice Artist scholarships, plus a Regional Protege audition that leads to the Elite Protege competition at RADIX Nationals.

items.name: Monsters Dance Orlando
items.when: April 23-25, 2027; the site lists a Summer Finale July 27-30, 2027.
items.why_john: The hip hop and commercial side of your training gets real reps here, close to home.

items.name: 24 Seven Orlando: Non-Stop Dancer Audition
items.when: April 30 to May 2, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency Orlando; 24 Seven Atlanta is March 12-14, 2027.
items.age_rule: Senior is 16-19, by age on January 1, 2027. Winning in one city makes you ineligible for another city's Non-Stop Dancer.
items.why_john: A late-season Best Dancer door, about eight weeks before The Dance Awards Orlando.

items.name: Tremaine Daytona Beach
items.when: May 1-2, 2027 (convention and semi-finals competition) at the Hilton Daytona Beach Oceanfront Resort.
items.why_john: A spring Tremaine stop near home if the studio wants another solo outing before summer nationals.

items.name: The Dance Awards 2027: Orlando
items.when: June 26 to July 3, 2027, listed under The Dance Awards logo on the JUMP, NUVO and 24 Seven sites.
items.age_rule: Best Dancer is only open to JUMP VIP, NUVO Breakout Artist and 24 Seven Non-Stop Dancer winners and runners-up.
items.why_john: This is the big one: Senior Best Dancer, in your home city.

items.name: The Dance Awards 2027: Las Vegas
items.when: July 12-18, 2027, listed under The Dance Awards logo on the JUMP, NUVO and 24 Seven sites.
items.age_rule: Same Best Dancer qualification as Orlando; the scholarship pages say Las Vegas OR Orlando.
items.why_john: The other Best Dancer stage if Orlando's week doesn't work for the team.

items.name: NYCDA Nationals 2027 (New York City and Phoenix)
items.when: NYCDA says it will host two 2027 national finales in New York City and Phoenix; 2027 dates aren't posted yet.
items.where: New York, NY or Phoenix, AZ
items.why_john: If you win Regional Outstanding Dancer in Orlando, this is where the National OD title and the $1,000 award are decided.

items.name: Dance Educators of America: Florida Regionals and Nationals
items.when: DEA's 2027 tour page shows South Florida (Feb 26-28) and Orlando (Apr 16-18), but the images are labeled 2021, so treat those as unconfirmed; Nationals is in Ponte Vedra, FL in early July.
items.where: Orlando, FL / South Florida / Ponte Vedra, FL
items.why_john: DEA has a title competition and college scholarships, and every stop listed for Florida is drivable.

items.name: YoungArts National Arts Competition (2028 cycle)
items.when: The 2027 application closed October 6, 2026; the 2028 application opens summer 2027 and its deadline isn't posted yet.
items.age_rule: YoungArts says ages 15-18 OR grades 10-12, in the U.S. You turn 18 next October, so ask YoungArts whether you'd still qualify by age as a college freshman.
items.why_john: Awards ran $250 to $10,000 last cycle, and it's the only road to Presidential Scholar in the Arts; if you're eligible by age, don't miss it twice.

items.name: U.S. Presidential Scholars in the Arts 2027
items.when: Nominees come only from YoungArts winners; the 2025 nominees were named in January and the medallion ceremony is in Washington, DC in June 2027.
items.age_rule: High school seniors graduating January to June 2027; U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
items.why_john: Only matters if you applied to YoungArts by October 6, 2026; if you did, keep an eye out for news in early 2027.

items.name: Florida Bright Futures (Florida Financial Aid Application)
items.when: The class of 2027 can file the Florida Financial Aid Application starting October 1, 2026, and it must be in before August 31 after graduation.
items.age_rule: Florida high school seniors; GPA, test score and service hour rules are in the current Bright Futures handbook.
items.why_john: It's free money for any Florida college or university, and the form takes one evening; do it this fall so it's done.

items.name: Dr. Phillips Center Applause Awards
items.when: Usually a late-spring ceremony (the 2026 one was May 30, 2026); 2027 dates aren't posted yet.
items.age_rule: Central Florida high school students, entered through their school's musical theater program.
items.why_john: It has a dancing category and college scholarships for seniors, but only if your high school's show enters.

items.name: Capezio A.C.E. Awards (choreography)
items.when: Past years took video entries of group choreography in spring, and finalists performed at the summer Dance Teacher Summit; 2027 dates and rules aren't posted.
items.age_rule: Not confirmed; check the 2027 rules for a minimum age.
items.why_john: You already choreograph, and the top prize has been a $15,000 production budget.

items.name: Florida Dance Education Organization (FDEO)
items.when: FDEO runs a yearly state conference for teachers and students that moves around Florida; 2026-27 dates and any student scholarships aren't posted yet find them.
items.why_john: A cheap way to take master classes from Florida college faculty you may audition for.

items.name: Steps on Broadway Pre-Professional Summer Intensive
items.when: Auditions open November 1, 2026 (solo video through Acceptd); three sessions run June 28-July 10, July 12-24 and July 26-August 7, 2027.
items.age_rule: Ages 10-18, by audition.
items.cost: $50 audition fee; tuition on the Tuition & Aid page.
items.why_john: Contemporary, jazz and tap all live at Steps, and a 1-3 minute solo video is all it takes to apply.

items.name: Hubbard Street Dance Chicago: TEEN CREATE / TEEN EXPLORE
items.when: In-person auditions run January 9 to February 20, 2027 (teens can do Zoom Jan 16, LA Feb 6, Chicago Feb 13 or NYC Feb 20); video auditions are due February 21, 2027.
items.age_rule: Teen programs start at age 13; teens audition in the 13-17 band.
items.cost: Not listed on the audition page; the page mentions a free video audition week, October 19-25, without naming the year, so ask.
items.why_john: Hubbard Street is contemporary at the top level, and you can audition by video without leaving Orlando.

items.name: The Ailey School Professional Division Summer Intensive
items.when: Video auditions for 2027 reopen November 17, 2026, and the 2027 in-person tour dates are being announced this month.
items.where: New York, NY (video or tour audition)
items.age_rule: Professional Division Summer Intensive: ages 16-25.
items.why_john: Horton, ballet and Ailey rep would sharpen your contemporary, and it's a feeder into the Ailey Certificate and Ailey/Fordham BFA.

items.name: Joffrey NY Jazz & Contemporary Summer Intensive
items.when: July 12 to August 6, 2027; the Pre-Professional Jazz & Contemporary runs June 7-25 and Pre-Professional Contemporary runs August 9-20, 2027.
items.age_rule: Not listed on the program page; audition required (digital submission available).
items.why_john: A four-week jazz and contemporary block in NYC, which are exactly your two strongest styles.

items.name: Joffrey Miami Jazz & Contemporary Summer Intensive
items.when: July 19-30, 2027; registration for 2027 programs opens January 2027.
items.age_rule: Not listed; audition required (digital submission available).
items.why_john: Two weeks of Joffrey jazz and contemporary without a flight, and it fits after The Dance Awards Orlando.

items.name: Joffrey South Jazz & Contemporary
items.when: June 14 to July 9, 2027.
items.age_rule: Not listed; audition required.
items.why_john: The Southeast option, but it overlaps The Dance Awards Orlando week, so it only works if you skip part of it.

items.name: Paul Taylor Professional Summer Intensive
items.when: June 14-25, 2027 at Taylor Dance East; no application deadline listed yet.
items.age_rule: Ages 17+ (the Teen Intensive is 13+).
items.cost: $30 application fee; $1,700 tuition, $200 off if paid before April 1, 2027.
items.why_john: You just turned 17, so you're old enough for the professional track, and Taylor technique builds real weight and stamina.

items.name: The School at Jacob's Pillow: Contemporary
items.when: 2027 applications open late fall 2026; last cycle had a late-January priority deadline and a late-February regular deadline.
items.age_rule: The 2026 rule was at least 16 on arrival day, no exceptions.
items.cost: Last cycle's processing fee was $45-$55 depending on the deadline.
items.why_john: It's one of the most respected contemporary programs in the country, and you're old enough now.

items.name: American Dance Festival: Pre-Professional Dance Intensive (PDI)
items.when: Usually early summer in Durham, NC; 2027 dates and deadlines aren't posted yet.
items.age_rule: PDI is ages 13-17; the main Summer Dance Intensive is 18+.
items.why_john: ADF is serious modern and contemporary training, and you fit PDI's age range for one more summer.

items.name: Bates Dance Festival: Young Dancers Intensive
items.when: Usually summer in Maine; 2027 dates and deadlines aren't posted yet.
items.age_rule: Ages 14-18; YDI Extensions is for advanced students 16-18.
items.why_john: A contemporary-heavy festival where advanced teens train next to the professional program.

items.name: Parsons Dance Summer Intensive
items.when: Usually two weeks in June (2026 had a March 1 scholarship deadline); 2027 dates aren't posted yet.
items.age_rule: Dancers under 18 must email intensives@parsonsdance.org before registering.
items.why_john: Athletic, musical contemporary rep that would show off your jumps and partnering.

items.name: Complexions Academy Summer Intensives
items.when: Past summers ran one-week programs in places like Boston and Los Angeles; 2027 dates aren't posted yet.
items.age_rule: Past programs were for ages 12-13 and up.
items.why_john: Contemporary ballet with a commercial edge, which is right in your lane.

items.name: National High School Dance Festival
items.when: March 6-10, 2027 at Point Park University; college and summer program scholarship auditions are March 6 and 7.
items.age_rule: Grades 9-12, attending through a high school; private studios are not eligible.
items.why_john: One weekend of scholarship auditions in front of dozens of colleges and summer programs, if your high school takes a group.

items.name: The Ailey School Certificate Program (2027-28)
items.when: Video auditions for the 2027-28 school year reopen November 17, 2026; in-person tour dates are being announced this month.
items.where: New York, NY (video or tour audition)
items.age_rule: Ages 17-23.
items.why_john: A full-time conservatory path straight out of high school if you'd rather train than start a BFA right away.

items.name: Steps on Broadway Professional Training Programs
items.when: Last cycle's fall program deadline was March 1, 2026; fall 2027 dates aren't posted yet.
items.age_rule: The program page says ages 17+, but the Academy page sends graduates ages 18-28 here, so confirm.
items.why_john: A full-time NYC program with jazz, contemporary and tap, built for dancers heading into the industry.

items.name: Peridance Certificate Program
items.when: Usually auditions run January to April in NYC and on tour, with video accepted; 2027 dates aren't posted yet.
items.where: New York, NY (video or tour audition)
items.age_rule: Ages 17+ (older pages say 17-25) with a high school diploma by the start date.
items.cost: $30 application fee for the Ballet/Contemporary track.
items.why_john: A two-year program with a Commercial track and a Ballet/Contemporary track, so you don't have to pick one side of yourself.

items.name: Broadway Dance Center Professional Semester
items.when: BDC runs a Professional Semester audition tour; 2027 dates aren't posted yet.
items.age_rule: Past materials say ages 18-27, so a spring 2028 start may be the first one that fits.
items.cost: A 2023 program document listed tuition at $4,750.
items.why_john: Four months of ballet, jazz, contemporary, hip hop and tap plus mock auditions, which matches how many styles you already do.

items.name: Ailey/Fordham BFA in Dance
items.when: Fordham's admission page says November 1 (Early Action) for both the Common App and the Ailey application, though another Fordham page says November 8, so confirm; auditions run December to February.
items.age_rule: High school seniors applying for fall 2027.
items.cost: $45 audition fee if invited, plus the Fordham application.
items.why_john: A BFA that pairs Ailey training with a full university degree in NYC, but it's the earliest deadline on this list.

items.name: Boston Conservatory at Berklee: BFA Contemporary or Commercial Dance
items.when: Early Action deadline is November 1 and regular deadline is December 1; auditions run November 14, 2026 to February 13, 2027, including Atlanta on January 3, 2027 (Early Action only) and online dates.
items.age_rule: Early Action applicants must apply by November 1 and audition by January 20.
items.cost: Application fee $75 through November 1, $150 through December 1.
items.why_john: It has both a contemporary and a commercial BFA, and Atlanta is the closest audition stop.

items.name: UNCSA School of Dance (Contemporary)
items.when: Priority date is November 2, 2026 (best audition slots, and video auditions are reviewed in order); final deadline is January 20, 2027; on-campus auditions are January 30, February 6 and February 13, 2027.
items.why_john: A conservatory with a contemporary concentration, and you can audition by video.

items.name: Juilliard BFA in Dance
items.when: Juilliard's admissions page lists Tuesday, December 1 as the BFA Dance deadline, with prescreen video results around December 20 and in-person callbacks after that; confirm the 2027 callback dates on Juilliard's site.
items.why_john: The prescreen is a video, so the only cost of trying is a weekend of filming.

items.name: Point Park University BFA Dance
items.when: On-campus auditions November 14 and December 5, 2026, and February 14 and 27, 2027; New York City January 16, 2027; audition by March 15, 2027 to be considered for merit scholarships.
items.age_rule: You must be academically admitted before scheduling a dance audition.
items.why_john: Point Park is known for jazz and contemporary, your two best styles.

items.name: Florida State University BFA Dance
items.when: In-person auditions October 28, 2026, January 13, 2027 and February 10, 2027; last cycle, applications after January 8 weren't considered for the January and February dates.
items.age_rule: Apply to FSU first with Dance as your major; Early Decision isn't allowed for dance, but Florida residents can apply Early Action.
items.why_john: In-state tuition and Bright Futures, and a full-day audition you can drive to.

items.name: University of South Florida BFA Dance
items.when: In-person auditions October 23 and November 20, 2026, and January 15 and February 12, 2027 (registration closes 48 hours before); video through Acceptd until February 26; USF applications are due March 1.
items.age_rule: You need a 90-second-or-less solo, plus ballet and contemporary classes.
items.why_john: In-state and an hour and a half away, and you can choreograph your own solo for it.

items.name: UCF Dance Minor Audition
items.when: Fall audition is Saturday, October 17, 2026, 9am-12pm, which clashes with JUMP, so look at the spring date instead; the spring 2027 date isn't posted yet.
items.age_rule: For UCF students; this is a minor, not a BFA.
items.why_john: Only worth it if you go to UCF for something else and want to keep dancing for credit.
